title: Which service stops which threat
claim: Ask where the threat travels, and the answer names the service that stops it.
alt: A ladder of four questions. A flood of packets: AWS Shield. Harmful content or too many requests in web traffic: AWS WAF. Traffic that enters or leaves a VPC and needs domain or protocol rules: AWS Network Firewall. The same rules in every account: AWS Firewall Manager.

rungs.q: Is it a flood of packets?

leave a VPC?
